description: Change the slot or quantity of a pending, awaiting_payment or confirmed booking, when the customer asks to. Replaces the booking's time or quantity and frees the old place. Use a slot value from get_availability. A booking paid online can change its slot but not its quantity (cancel and rebook instead). Changes close at the same cutoff as online cancellation.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key (8–64 letters, digits, _ . : -) that makes retries safe: the same key with the same parameters returns the original result

quantity.description: New number of people or places

name: modify_booking
title: Change a booking
